## 3. Reference fact kinds and schemas

- **ef4.tick.seed**: instrument_id=target entity; session_id=target session; reference_id=x1:B(seed_set_id), caller supplied; effective_start_ns=event time of the last eligible print before the open (utc_ns, strictly before the session open); effective_end_ns=the session open; text=carried sign, exactly one of '+', '-', '0'; price=that print's price coefficient (positive int64, same price_unit and adjustment as the trades batch); factor_num/factor_den=null; known_at_ns=original knowledge, nullable
- **note**: The seed batch carries a price column, so it needs a price_unit and require_compatible_inputs applies between trades and seed (scale or currency difference INVALID_UNIT, adjustment difference UNSUPPORTED_ADJUSTMENT). Rows within one (instrument, session) group follow the shared REFERENCE order rule. No other fact kind is accepted in the seed role (INVALID_SCHEMA).

The schemas are listed for the whole core contract file, that is for all of its producers.

## 5. Coverage, adjustment, scale, known_at and mode rules

- **mode_rule**: known_at mode raises unknown_availability and future_knowledge; reconstruction mode (separate config identity) raises neither (AvailabilitySpec.knowledge_reason returns None); batch and full replay only for both producers; merge supported only for the notional top-K under the conditions of DP-K6; update and restore unsupported
- **seed_kind_rule**: ef4.tick.seed is the only new reference fact kind: one fact per target entity and session, exactly when seed_policy is supplied; see reference_fact_schemas
- **layer_responsibilities**:
  - **library**: admission of the supplied facts, window and closure selection, the tick chain, totals, ranking, merge, quality, evidence and every library refusal; pure and deterministic with exact integer intermediates and one final float rounding; the two producers share only the trade admission
  - **io_ef4**: maps ordered TRADE rows with order_key, event_id, eligibility and original known_at, the optional seed fact and the session scope exactly as supplied; maps results (int64, decimal128 coefficient, float64 hex-exact, TOP_K_TRADES cell, status, reasons, counts, witnesses) unchanged; never sorts, deduplicates, nets, imputes, converts scale or currency, derives a seed, chooses a window or computes a sign or a rank
  - **worker_ef4**: routes selected outputs with their row closure, keeps per-identity tape order and the sign carry, runs independent partitions and merges only the declared compatible partials, executes one config per complete result, binds inputs and the config digest and persists the library result unchanged; direct, adapter, worker and stored results are identical including refusal class
